findings.value: A club beside Old Street roundabout in Shoreditch, established in 2010. Time Out says its draw is its experimental and emerging-artist gigs, and the venue's own site presents it as newly rebuilt and aimed at forward-thinking music.

evidence.quote: the black box next to Old Street roundabout
A rebuilt space for forward-thinking sound.

findings.value: Time Out highlights its experimental and emerging-artist gigs; the venue lists club nights and all-dayers, including drum and bass and house, and a new weekly Thursday night.

evidence.quote: mainly for the decent amount of gigs with experimental and up-and-coming artists it hosts
